entities.summary: Hardinge Stanley Giffard, 1st Earl of Halsbury was a British barrister and Conservative politician. He served three times as Lord High Chancellor of Great Britain, for a total of seventeen years, a record not equalled by anyone except Lords Hardwicke and Eldon.
